I told Dana in a thread reply in #north-team that the deadline is 19 November, so that's the date for her tracker.

Marcus first posted 21 December in #north-team on the 14th. The same morning he corrected it in #north-random to 19 November, saying he'd read the wrong line. Nothing has changed since. Dana is in #north-random, and so is everyone else in #north-team, so it was fine to repeat the correction there.

The brain still has the old 21 December note. I tried to mark it as replaced, but it wouldn't accept the note's id. The 19 November correction is saved there too, so a search will show both dates. Marcus's original post in #north-team also still says 21 December.
